newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle active at $113/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle active at $113/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trade fairly active on Tuesday, USDA said. Steers and heifers were fully steady on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).
Dressed Basis Steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1350 lbs 112.00 to mostly 113.00. (weighted average 112.88).
Dressed Basis Heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 112.00 to mostly 113.00. (weighted average 112.88)

Prices were not fully established on slaughter steers or heifers on a live basis, few sales steady to $1.00 lower than last week. Buyer inquiry and demand good, seller interest mixed. Live basis sales: Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers: Few Select and Choice 2-3 1250 lbs 70.00. Slaughter Heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1175 lbs 70.00, few 69.50.
Wk To Date: 21,100 Sm Pd Lst Wk: 4,400 Sm Pd Lst Yr: 23,300
